title: Forza Horizon
shortDescription: Playground Games merges Turn 10's authentic physics with a music and car festival across Colorado highways.
historicalSignificance: Created the premier open-world racing franchise in the world, balancing festival celebration with superb driving feel.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
